text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while training for the Unicorn<n>Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mnggghhhh! We just keep doing the<n>same thing
over and over again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I can't take it anymore... I'm outta<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Don't hey me! I'll come back whenyou've thought of something fun forme to do! Naa-naa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I knew from the beginning she<n>wasn't
well-behaved. Maybe the<n>reason she was able to
focus before<n>now was because she was gearing<n>up
for her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to find a new way to<n>reinvigorate her, and
fast! But how?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Sorry to interrupt. Trainer, do you<n>have a minute?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I have wonderful news. An amazing<n>offer came in
for Shinko Windy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes! A variety TV program is<n>organizing a race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's for one of their most popular<n>segments. By the
sound of it, the race<n>will be broadcast live on TV and
streamed online.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Big-time TV personalities and<n>celebrities get to
nominate their<n>favorite Umamusume to participate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it just so happens one of them<n>liked what they
saw in Shinko<n>Windy's debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's only an exhibition race, so the<n>results won't
contribute to her<n>record... but it's still a great
opportunity to gain some national<n>attention!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To sum things up, Shinko Windy has<n>been
nominated by one of their<n>regular cast members.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this new opportunity to make an<n>impression,
she's bound to get<n>serious about her training
again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Lackey! You finally ready to have<n>some fun? Huh?
Tazuna? Whatcha<n>doin' here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her about the TV show<n>and the event
race they're hosting.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Did you just say a nationalbroadcast?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll do it! I'll do it! I'll do it! Sign me up<n>now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're telling me all of Japan's<n>gonna get the
chance to see me!<n>There's no way I'm not
running!
choice_data_list: Then we'd better train hard to make sure you win.
Then we'd better train hard to make sure you win.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No duh! That's common sense! I'm<n>going in fangs
bared!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Aww yeah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Once I trample over my<n>rivals, the whole
world of racing's<n>gonna be talking about me!
Guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Get a regimen drawn up,<n>pronto!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm already strong, but I<n>wanna get so
strong and win so big<n>that everyone can't help but
look my<n>way!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I wish you the best of luck. ♪<n>The academy
will support you in any<n>way we can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From that point on...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hfff! Gimme more!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! That's 100 hundred-meter<n>laps in the pool
down! And I got more<n>in me still!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! I said I can keep going! Don't<n>you give me
that "resting is part of<n>training" spiel again!
choice_data_list:
Umm... Oh! Did you see there are squirt guns in the
shed?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So what? Now ain't the time for<n>pranks!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Get with it, will ya? You may be an<n>adult, but you
got the attention span<n>of a child right now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Find me sitting down next to the pool.<n>I'll be
rehydrating and reading up on<n>race strategies.
choice_data_list: (I've never seen her this motivated before!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Graaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm? Where's Windy getting all that<n>drive from?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I guess she actually has bite behind<n>her bark.
Heheh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I won't be outdone! First,<n>another lap, then...
a G1 victory!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff! Wheeew!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Late at night is when bad guys like<n>me get to work.
And darkness is the<n>perfect cover...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: To get in tons of visualization training.<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In first place, it's Shinko Windy!<n>She's strong! Too
strong! All hail<n>Wicked Windy! What a magnificent
victory!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! WAHAHAHAAA! Didja<n>see that?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gasp! How?! How could I let her beatme by such a record-breakingdistance?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how fast she was! I'll<n>still be talking
about this race even a<n>hundred years from now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What can I say? I guess my power isjust that fearsome. MWAHAHAHAA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hm-hmmm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
Who's in there training right now?!<n>Do you have
any idea what time it is?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh shoot! Guards showed up! Gotta<n>split!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy continues her dutiful<n>training, day in
and day out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! How's my time?
choice_data_list: You got a new personal record!
You got a new personal record!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heeheehee...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WAHAHAHAAA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm the strongest around! Period!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've got this race in the bag! The<n>Windy Generation
is coming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's grown by leaps and bounds in<n>almost no
time at all. I knew I was<n>right about her. When
she's dialed in,<n>she's nearly unstoppable!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'mma win.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'mma go down in history with the<n>biggest win ever
seen, and I'm<n>gonna do it in front of the entire
country!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With how strong she is, I have no<n>doubt that she'll
manage to seize the<n>glory she's pursuing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But little did I know...
